decisive_items: remote history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (7 years prior) and bladder urothelial carcinoma (10 years prior)
a new, painless but bothersome swelling over the pacemaker site
response.rationale: Infection and hematoma are explicitly excluded. In a patient with prior smoking-related malignancies, a new hypervascular soft-tissue mass around the pacemaker pocket is most consistent with metastatic disease rather than a primary pocket tumor or lymphoma.

rejected.why: Infection was explicitly excluded by imaging.
No specific clinical or imaging features of lymphoma are provided beyond a vascular mass.
